topic: Day 92 — reel — Ambition without rest is just burnout with better branding
text:
Ambition
without rest is
burnout with
better [branding].
caption:
Pushing with no recovery isn't more ambitious, it just ends sooner. Rest is a component of the goal, not a break from it.
